expect: md: bare assertion counts as asserted

name: the retirement-marker vocabulary is emptied, so every deliberate correction note reads as a fresh assertion
expect: md: the correction glyph alone marks a retirement
html: inline marker is a quotation

expect: md: marker in a DIFFERENT block does not exempt

expect:
html: bare

is an assertion

name: the enclosing-element classes are discarded, so a note ancestor no longer exempts a quotation
expect: html: class=note is a quotation
html: nested inside a note ancestor is a quotation

name: a re-asserted retired claim is no longer reported
expect: audit: a re-asserted retired claim is a problem

name: a live claim missing from every site is no longer reported, so a fold that never landed passes
expect: audit: a LIVE claim absent from all its sites is a problem

name: a derived figure disagreeing with its source is accepted, which is backlog B2 reinstated
expect: audit: a derived figure disagreeing with its source is a problem

name: a page that declares no derived figure is assumed correct, which is the fail-open B2 would reinstate
expect: audit: a missing derived element is a problem

name:
void elements are pushed onto the stack, so one
inside a carrier swallows the rest of the page
edits:
if tag.lower() not in self.VOID:
            self.stack.append((tag, a))
expect: derived: a void element carrying the attribute captures nothing

name: partial propagation is no longer reported, so a fold that updated one site of two passes
expect: audit: a LIVE claim at the spec and NOT the page is a problem
audit: and the problem NAMES the site the fold missed

name: the served page stops being an audited site, so the fragment can disagree with what a reader opens
edits: if PAGE in out and PAGE_HTML not in out:
expect: audit: a token in the fragment and NOT the served page is a problem
audit: a derived figure wrong ONLY in the served page is a problem

name: HTML matching returns to one text node at a time, so inline markup hides a registered claim
edits:
for blk in p.blocks:
        data = flat(blk["text"])
expect: html: the SAME words split by inline markup are still asserted

name: whitespace normalisation is dropped, so rewrapping a paragraph makes a registered claim vanish
expect: md: a token split by a LINE BREAK is still found
html: a token split by a LINE BREAK is still found

name: an ordinary English word returns to the retirement vocabulary, so incidental prose exempts a re-asserted retired rule
expect: html: ordinary prose containing 'no longer' does NOT exempt an assertion
md: ordinary prose containing 'no longer' does NOT exempt an assertion
